Now that I have a detailed experimental protocol, the next critical step is to ensure we have all the necessary materials. I will use the `Reagent` agent to check the availability of all the reagents listed in the protocol.

My reasoning for this is that an experiment cannot be performed without the required reagents. The `Reagent` agent will check our lab's inventory for every single item on the list generated by the `Protocol` agent. This will prevent any delays or issues that could arise from missing materials and allow us to proceed with the experiment with confidence.

For the `reagent_query_id` parameter, I will provide the ID of the file generated by the `Protocol` agent (`Protocol-87d1`). This file contains the comprehensive list of reagents that need to be checked. This ensures that the `Reagent` agent has the exact information it needs to perform the inventory check. I will not set the `gather_mode` to `True` since I don't need a summary of all reagents but a check on the specific ones for this experiment.
